hypotheses.claim: A rank-based (monotone-invariant) power transform of removal savings with multiplicative gating (gates on route load ratio, depot-adjacency, demand, and route distance) outperforms plain worst-removal scoring on dev_24 hetero instances at 500 ms, because rank normalization removes scale heterogeneity across instances while the stagnation-driven exponent switches from local (small exponent, exploit) to global (large exponent, diversify) destruction without introducing RNG nondeterminism.

next_search_advice.direction: Ruin-priority scoring as a stagnation-adaptive rank-power rule: normalize per-node removal savings by run-scale, multiply load/depot/demand/route-distance gating factors, then rank-transform and raise to an exponent that grows with stagnation_ratio (mild when improving, aggressive when stuck) to diversify destroy sets under the 500 ms anytime budget.
